data.text: I’m with you, John—10 tons each is the most we can share equally every month while keeping the lake full. Luke, your 100 tons would earn $100,000 once; ten tons a month beats that in eleven months and leaves you a livelihood afterward. My family taught me to fish here, and I won’t help turn our village’s future into a scramble for one last catch. Let’s make the agreement practical: fish together, weigh catches at the dock, and stop at 10 tons apiece. I’ll accept those same checks on my catch. Luke, will you withdraw your demand and join us on those terms?
